headline: Lane entry is decided by query-token coverage of the indexed path (18.3x lift for top-10), not by installs, stars or publisher authority; our flagship lane is uncontested and our own listing is unindexed at T+12.4h.
claim: Across 16 queries / 2,972 rows, P(top-10 | all query tokens in repo+slug path) = 0.281 vs 0.0153 otherwise. Median installs of top-10 token-matching rows (408) are 6x lower than top-10 non-matching rows (2,457); 44/121 token-matching top-10 rows have <100 installs. Top-10 repo diversity is 8-10 distinct repos per head lane, so no incumbent lock. The 'market research playbook' lane has 27 rows, one all-token listing at rank 8 with 9 installs, and 24/27 rows under 10 installs; our market-research-playbook page is HTTP 200 (40,894 bytes, no counter) but appears in 0 of 16 queries and 0 of 2 owner-query rows.

method.approach: Read-only GETs to the public skills.sh search API and listing pages, plus owner-query index probe. All aggregation in scripts; only counts, ranks, medians and shares returned to context.
method.queries_detail: 13 head lanes (market research, competitive analysis, competitor analysis, customer research, business research, swot analysis, campaign planning, voice of customer, seo audit, brand strategy, sales skills, marketing strategy) + 3 qualifier lanes (market research report, market research playbook, research report workflow, competitive analysis report)

concentration.implication: no publisher monopoly; new repos can hold multiple top-10 slots

operational_actions: Fix index presence of market-research-playbook first; it is the only listing in the flagship lane with all tokens and it is invisible.
Stand up a 16-query rank-probe time series (index presence + rank of our listings per lane); installs are out of the KPI set.
Pick lanes we can match token-for-token in path and publish literal-token slugs; the target lane 'market research playbook' has one 9-install incumbent.
Treat any insight containing [mock-llm] as a failed run (D104).

falsifiers.F-b: in >=25% of head lanes the first all-token listing ranks below 20
falsifiers.F-c: after indexing, market-research-playbook is absent from the top-10 of its own query despite a 3-token slug
falsifiers.F-d: non-matching top-10 rows explained by description text invisible to the API

risk: Single-day cross-section on an Algolia-backed index; ranking may be personalised or time-varying. API exposes no description field, so F-d is only testable after our own listing is indexed.
